content.rendered:
The quality ain’t great on this one, but it’s a chance to hear Bruce  and Beaver Brown cover this rarely-performed Fats Domino 1955 classic at the raucous Big Man’s West in Red Bank, New Jersey, back in 1982. Bruce has covered this song five times over the years, but only in small club or bar appearances.

Bonus: here’s a fantastic clip of Fats himself performing it in the 1956 movie, Shake, Rattle & Rock!

Ain’t That a Shame
First performed: April 15, 1979 (Asbury Park, NJ)
Last performed: February 2, 1992 (New Orleans, LA)

© March 8, 2018

excerpt.rendered: Bruce and Beaver Brown cover a Fats Domino classic at Big Man’s West in 1982.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Let the Four Winds Blow
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Way back in 1974, Bruce and the E Street Band paid homage to Fats Domino with a mash-up of two singles by the New Orleans rock pioneer.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Do You Want to Dance
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: One time only: Listen to Bruce Springsteen join Rhode Island rockers Beaver Brown in a joyful cover of Bobby Freeman’s “Do You Want to Dance” in a surprise appearance in the summer of 1982.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Money (That’s What I Want)
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce Springsteen has covered Motown's first big hit several times over the years, but only two club performances from the eighties were caught on tape. Take a listen to both inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Come On, Let’s Go
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce and Cats on a Smooth Surface cover Ritchie Valens' very first hit.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Billy Bragg: Mansion on the Hill
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: From the wonderful 2003 Light of Day tribute album comes this wonderfully fresh perfectly suited arrangement of "Mansion on the Hill."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Ain’t That Lovin’ You Baby
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Twice only: Bruce covered Elvis Presley's 1964 hit during two appearances in the same week at Jersey Shore clubs.
